summary: Qfin Holdings filed a Form 6-K disclosing an orderly CEO succession: Haisheng Wu stepped down as CEO, director and compensation-committee member to focus on the company's international business, and the board appointed Yan Zheng, previously vice president and chief risk officer, as CEO and director effective September 21, 2026. Wu remains with the company, ensuring transition continuity; chairman Fan Zhao endorsed both executives. No deal terms, advisors, premium, stake or regulatory clock are involved. Watch execution risk around international expansion, risk-policy continuity under a career risk officer, and any strategic-review or capital-return signal from the new CEO.
